findings.issue: `hyperbolicToTensor_ι_base` and `hyperbolicToTensor_ι_hyperbolic` each re-derive `(matrixEquivTensor _ _ _).symm (matrixEquivTensor _ _ _ m) = m` by expanding into the `Matrix.single` sum (`map_sum`, `Fintype.sum_prod_type`, `Matrix.single_apply`) instead of using `AlgEquiv.symm_apply_apply`, duplicating the same eight-line block twice.

summary: The main equivalence is new and correctly reuses `realCliffordOneOneEquivMatrix` and Mathlib's `Prod.lean` commutation lemmas, but the scaffolding restates existing Mathlib lemmas verbatim (`Prod.fst_add_snd`, `AlgEquiv.toAlgHom_ofAlgHom`/`ofAlgHom_apply`) and repeats the same computations in several places. The public generator API also carries three lemmas where one suffices.
